## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear description of what the problem is. E.g. "I'm always frustrated when …"

## Proposed solution
What you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered
Other solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Scope / layer
Which part does this touch? (engine routing / TM / distillation / glossary / voice / UI / cross-platform / FFI API)

## Privacy / license impact
Does it keep data on-device and stay on the Apache-2.0 / MIT stack? (Wonslate is privacy-first and commercially usable.)

## Additional context
Add any other context, mockups, or links here.
